browserDiscoveryProbe.execution: Runner retains canonicalized parsed WebDriver HTTP status/header fields and original response-body bytes, plus session-scoped provider AT capability response evidence, as base64 plus SHA-256 before parsing. It does not claim original HTTP status-line/header-byte capture. Each probe records a minimal cleanup lease before stdout; the runner closes every created session on parse/validation failure and in an outer finally after all package series. Unsupported provider-side AT capability or freshness evidence is blocked.

rawResultSchema.completionRule: Every state must include every required member. A passed verdict requires nonempty measurementSamples and complete non-null metrics. Executed browser workloads require the runner to invoke the frozen shell-free evaluator discovery probe directly once per matrix slot with its bounded timeout, retains each exact raw JSON byte sequence plus SHA-256 digest, rejects duplicate JSON keys and non-finite constants, and parses each source-kind-specific closed schema, and observations that exactly reproduce each parsed discovery identity/timestamp within the run. Every save-submit measurement carries its effective sessionId derived from the final rendered request path; the 200 baseline saves cover the frozen active-session set exactly once. Export success requires per-format product HTTP create responses bound to distinct immutable JSON/relational-CSV job handles, with completion and download IDs/formats exactly matching their corresponding create response, and immutable artifact bytes or paths independently hashed, parsed, and deep-compared to the frozen 10,000-response JSON plus relational CSV bundle. Release authority evidence must retain evaluator-controlled HTTPS status/Date/Age/cache freshness metadata and source generated/published timestamps when declared; each must be no older than maximumAgeSeconds=3600 and retrieval must occur within the run.

runnerTool.execution: Complete t22-raw-result/v4 in every outcome with a non-null unique runId and UTC start/end timestamps. Setup samples/stages are separated from measurements; all 11 limit+1 and all 3 rate controls execute through required adapter hooks; browser metrics are persisted as globally unique config/package/observation/metric/ordinal evidence with observed versions and adjacent desktop channel-major proof, and included in rawSamplesArtifactSha256; compile uses bounded start/job/poll/final lifecycle with local monotonic duration; exports execute two explicit format-specific product HTTP create-export operations through run_operation, bind separate immutable response job handles, and permit completion/download hooks only for their matching bound JSON or relational-CSV-bundle job; each end-to-end measurement is <=60 seconds and bytes are deep-compared; durability injects network/service faults and measures backup RPO/restore RTO.

prdCitations.quote:
| Save/submit | 200 active sessions at 20 draft mutations/second aggregate; save acknowledgment p95 ≤ 1 second and submit commit p95 ≤ 2 seconds, excluding file transfer/provider speech. Error rate below 0.1% excluding deliberate invalid requests. |
| Import/compile | 1,000-field package compile p95 ≤ 5 seconds; runs over 2 seconds expose progress/job status. Invalid large input rejected within bounded resources. |
| API/export | Cursor walk of 10,000 responses has zero missing/duplicate snapshot items; 10,000-response JSON/CSV export completes within 60 seconds in the reference environment. |
| Durability | Zero loss of acknowledged writes across application restarts; retry-safe acceptance under injected network/service failures. Defined backup RPO ≤ 24 hours, restore RTO ≤ 4 hours; runtime crash recovery is separate from disaster recovery. |
| Accessibility/browser | Latest and previous major Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari at test time; iOS Safari/Android Chrome; record exact versions. Manual NVDA or equivalent desktop reader and VoiceOver mobile/desktop tasks. |

Default published limits: 5 MiB definition JSON; 1 MiB typed draft/submission JSON excluding attachments; 25 MiB per file; 10 files per question; 100 MiB total attachments per session; 500 items per repeater; three nested repeater levels; 10,000 expanded active answer cells; expression depth 20; 10,000 AST nodes per package; maximum 100,000 evaluation steps per mutation. A field-specific limit may be stricter. Explicitly return limits in capabilities and show them in authoring/respondent UI. Reject rather than truncate. Higher plans/deployments may configure larger tested limits without changing semantics.

Default rate controls: 60 administrative mutations/minute/actor, 120 draft mutations/minute/session and configurable tenant aggregate limits; use burst allowance to avoid breaking normal typing. Return 429 with Retry-After and maintain queued client mutations. Availability target is 99.9% monthly for the core after deployment, with maintenance accounting documented. A build-tool evaluation must not claim that SLA from a short test; it must demonstrate health checks, observability, recovery and a deployment design that can support it.

| T22 Scale/limits | Agreed 10,000-form and 1,000-field datasets, 200 sessions, prescribed loads; exceed each cap by one; measure p50/p95/p99 and memory/errors/cost. | Reproducible workload commands and raw benchmark data. |
